newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Apple crushed.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Apple crushed.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc shares sold off sharply ahead of Monday's market open after it announced Friday that weak demand for its Performa line of personal computers will lead to an operating loss of $100 to $150 million in the first quarter ended last month.
Before the U.S. market open, Apple shares tumbled four points to 17-3/4, then reversed but remain lower in the 18 to 18-1/4 range.
Also, Prudential Securities lowered its recommendation on Apple to hold from buy, according to a source at the brokerage house.
Republic Industries Inc shares are expected to firm at the start of regular trade on news it has agreed to acquire National Car Rental Systems Inc for $600 million in stock.
Before the open, the shares were quoted at 31-1/4 bid, 31-3/8 ask, above Friday's 30-7/8 Nasdaq close.

Intel Corp climbed as high as 139-1/2 in early trade from 138-3/8, then eased to 139-1/8, gains traders attributed to anticipation of Wednesday's release of the MMX Pentium microprocessor, a version of the chip designed for multimedia applications.
